headline: Tatung's September revenue down 13% year on year, deepening power infrastructure and AI computing layout | Industry & Finance
summary: Tatung reported September consolidated revenue of NT$3.687 billion, down 13.29% year on year. Nine-month revenue was NT$36.25 billion, down 2.13%, and the company plans to expand power infrastructure and AI computing.
why: Tatung is a Taiwanese conglomerate with consumer electronics and industrial businesses, and its monthly sales give a read on its core operations.
